verdict.rationale: Entrust Identity Verification is an identity-verification API/SDK platform with a no-code verification workflow builder. It has no AI agent or tool-using host component that could act as an MCP client, so plugging in MCP servers is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP-client or agent tool-use capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
